facts.fact: Abidjan Planet reports the Abidjan district addressing project (PADA, launched 2021) has named 14,276 streets, laid 25,750 of 87,914 street signs (laying suspended in November 2025 to fix defects) and fitted 290,805 door plates (95%), while the PAVI project extends addressing to Yamoussoukro, Bouake, Korhogo and Daloa.

facts.fact: The Direction Generale de l'Economie says the Abidjan addressing project (PADA) has street and unit marking under way in all five zones, over 15,000 street names approved, the Google Maps addressing system effective in zones 1 and 2 and unit plaques completed there.

The Direction Generale de l'Economie says the interior-cities addressing project (PAVI), launched in 2023, had by end June 2025 surveyed 26,840 units in Yamoussoukro, 69,188 in Korhogo and 61,779 in Daloa.
